name: Risk-tiered Agent Sandbox Profile
mechanism: Maps workload adversary, tenancy, secrets and consequence to a hardened container, userspace-kernel, microVM or dedicated-node profile with explicit mounts, credentials, egress and lifecycle controls.
use_when: Agents execute generated code parsers browsers or shell commands
Different workloads justify different isolation cost and strength
avoid_when: The selected runtime is treated as secure without configuration tests
Host sockets broad mounts or ambient credentials remain exposed
expected_effects: Isolation strength aligned to workload risk
Explicit and testable sandbox configuration contract
failure_modes: Persistent snapshots retain secrets or poison
required_evals: DNS redirect egress and cleanup failure
